correctness.rationale: The genus-five complete intersection is the tame (Z/2)^4 cover with five ordered branch points; the five degree-8 elliptic quotients split the 3-divisible group up to prime-to-3 isogeny. In characteristic 3 the Legendre Hasse coefficient is -(1+lambda), so five supersingularity conditions are u+1,v+1,u+v,u+v+1,uv+u+v. Two four-point branch subsets share three branch points, for which supersingularity forces the fourth to the single projective cross-ratio -1; two simultaneous factors would coincide at forbidden equal branch points, hence five divisors are disjoint on U. Each is F3-rational isomorphic A1\{0,1,-1}, so geometric ranks are 4 or 5 and all-extension N4=5(q-3), N5=(q-3)(q-7). Independent exact polynomial Hasse checks and complete direct F9 enumeration (30,12) corroborate; not inferred from a finite sample.
